text:
Priya: Quick async standup — kernel warmup + KV perf. TL;DR: merged small batcher change last night (PR #4123), canary runs show p95 latency -12% but p99 tail spike on shard-7 for long sequences. What I did / blockers / today:

Dan: Nice. which commit/sha?

Priya: sha abcdef1 — reduced microbatch window 8ms -> 6ms. Repro: `./bench/run --scenario=kv-warmup --shard=7`. Logs spike at iter 42.

Maya: On it. I started digging into KV metrics — adding tracing for `kv:evict` and `prefetch:miss`. Will look at slot allocation churn and hotset changes.

Alex: Pushed a small followup to avoid double-prefetch on cold starts (PR #4126). Can someone roll that to canary?

Priya: Yes please. @ops-bot canary?

ops-bot: @Priya canary rollout started: canary-57. Watch /deployments for status.

Sam: Noting a ~120MB worker memory bump on canary after #4126 — looks like an extra buffered queue allocation. I'll add instrumentation to narrow it down.

Jules: Reviewed #4126 — left one comment re: atomic swap in the batcher, otherwise LGTM.

Priya: Blocker update: if p99 persists after #4126, plan B is revert microbatch window to 8ms and tune prefetch thresholds. Also current kv-warmup harness caps seq len at 512; that might hide long-seq regressions. I opened issue #985 to extend to 2048.

Maya: I can extend the harness today and run longer sequences overnight.

Alex: Quick question — what's our staging eviction_threshold? staging config shows 0.7. I'm thinking try 0.75 on canary.

Sam: I'd be cautious bumping too far — warmer caches but longer warmup. Maybe test 0.75 first, collect warmup slope.

Priya: Agreed. Action items: Maya extend harness to 2k, Sam add memory + queue instrumentation, Alex spin up 0.75 experiment, Dan help run bench and gather logs. I'll post a short follow-up in #runtime-ops with results.

Dan: Happy to run bench today — ping me when canary stabilizes.

ops-bot: canary-57 health: 3/3 ok, 1 warning (memory). Rolling metrics to /deployments/57.

Priya: thanks all. If anyone finds a quick repro snippet (small script or command) drop it here — saves us iteration. Example bench command:```bash
./bench/run --scenario=kv-warmup --shard=7 --seq-len=2048 --iter=200
```

Maya: will post results here once overnight run completes.

Alex: I'll open a small experiment branch with eviction_threshold=0.75 and attach flamegraphs.

Sam: Instrumentation PR coming in 30m.

Jules: ping me for a quick review after PRs land.

Priya: perfect — closing this thread for now, will update with bench summary later. :thumbsup:
